dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Hey Mira, do you think we're chỉ friends? Sometimes I feel like we could be... something more.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: What? We're chỉ friends! Don't imagine weird things. We chỉ play cờ and talk. Nothing special.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: But every time we play cờ, I notice you nhìn at me for a long time. And you chỉ do that with me, not with others.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: That's chỉ a chess strategy! I nhìn to predict your next move. You nghĩ too much.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Then why do you chỉ play cờ with me? There are better players at the club, but you chỉ invite me.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I... I'm chỉ used to playing with you. Why do you keep asking such strange questions? We're chỉ friends, understand?
